articles.title: Bitcoin steadies near $81,700 as altcoins rebound, pepe climbs 13%
articles.description: Bitcoin rose 0.5% to around $81,700 since midnight UTC while the CoinDesk 80 gained 1.4% and memecoins climbed 2.9%.

articles.title: Bitcoin appears to have decoupled from midterm cycle bottom history
articles.description: Previous bitcoin bear-market lows followed U.S. midterms, but this year’s recovery raises the possibility that the bottom arrived months earlier.

articles.title: HSBC rolls out its first stablecoin to over 3 million everyday app users
articles.description: HSBC and Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint received Hong Kong’s first stablecoin issuer licenses in April. Anchorpoint began rolling out HKDAP in August.

articles.title: Sweden’s central bank revives e-krona debate as stablecoins and digital euro loom
articles.description: The Riksbank sees an e-krona as critical to securing national payments and monetary control.

articles.title: India's largest exchange denies hack after sleuths pointed to $16 million in suspicious outflows
articles.description: CoinDCX denies its active wallets were hacked after sleuths flagged $16 million in outflows from addresses linked to the India-based exchange.

articles.title: Polymarket has reportedly fired its marketing chief, also a close friend of the CEO
articles.description: Matthew Modabber was reportedly ousted after an internal probe of several instances of misconduct, according to the New York Post.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
articles.description: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.

articles.title: Cardano holders are being asked to bet $5 million on copper hitting a new record
articles.description: Toto Finance wants 22 million ADA from Cardano’s treasury to buy tokenized copper, and the metal would have to trade well above its all-time high for holders to get their money back.

articles.title: Bitcoin, gold trim early losses as yen gives up gains. Oil stays near $100
articles.description: Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil near $100 keeps inflation risks in focus.

articles.title: Senate's top Democratic investigator looking into Tether payments to Bo Hines' firm
articles.description: Senator Richard Blumenthal, the ranking Democrat on the investigations subcommittee, added a probe of the ex-White House crypto adviser to his list of crypto interests.

articles.title: A16z is the latest VC giant to widen bets beyond crypto and into AI and emerging tech
articles.description: The venture investor behind early bets on Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap said is broadening its focus, joining other crypto investment firms looking beyond blockchain to artificial intelligence and tech themes.

articles.title: Irish central bank fines Coinbase Ireland $3.6 million over fund safeguarding failures
articles.description: When Silvergate was on the verge of collapse in 2023, Coinbase instructed 30 customers to deposit funds into an alternate account held by Coinbase at another U.S. bank.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Stablecoins are ready for prime time
Crypto custody specialist Fireblocks denies it's in talks to be acquired by Visa
articles.description: The company is in talks with Visa over a potential $2.5 billion acquisition, Axios reported.

articles.title: Crypto is making a splash in U.S. elections — but chiefly in jabs about industry influence
articles.description: Boosters often say crypto voters can swing elections, but Democrats are seeking mileage out of tying crypto to Trump, corruption and attempts to buy seats in Congress.

articles.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
articles.description: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

articles.title: Crypto traders seek shelter in bitcoin as altcoins slide and ETF flows wobble
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 21, 2026

articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
articles.description: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

articles.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
articles.description: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls back to $81,000, with interest rates tumbling as stocks crack
articles.description: The Nasdaq is down more than 2% as the AI bull market trade continues to unwind. U.S. interest rates are plunging even as oil surges.

articles.title: Asian stocks tumble, bitcoin retreats as China enters bear market
articles.description: Technology shares led regional losses as mixed U.S. earnings unsettled investors and Brent crude climbed above $112 a barrel.

articles.title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
articles.description: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims’ claims to the coins.

articles.title: Solana’s biggest network change since 2020 is live. Here’s how users benefit
articles.description: The new voting system targets settlement in about 150 milliseconds, potentially shortening waits for payments and deposits. Users can keep their existing wallets.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
articles.description: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs. The funds are yet to match that pace, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.

articles.title: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
articles.description: The fix lost its two-week countdown less than two days from the finish after support slipped to 26 of 35 validators. It’s now back at 31.
